review_locator: PMID:29247683, Functional dissection of astrocyte-secreted proteins: Implications in brain health and diseases
primary_title: Mass spectrometric and computational analysis of cytokine-induced alterations in the astrocyte secretome
decision_basis: The astrocyte-secretome review leads to the primary study showing increased NGF in astrocyte-conditioned medium after inflammatory cytokine exposure.
limitations_preserved: Inflammatory triple-cytokine exposure increased measured NGF protein in mouse astrocyte-conditioned medium, especially after sustained exposure; preserve the exact combination and time course, distinguish NGF protein from Ngf transcript, and do not infer a defined receptor/TF mechanism or SCI weighting.

decision_basis: The astrocyte-secretome review leads to the primary study identifying CXCL1 as a cytokine-induced secreted protein and validating its cytokine-specific detection by Western blot.
limitations_preserved: CXCL1 protein was detected in cytokine-treated mouse astrocyte-conditioned medium and validated by Western blot; preserve the triple-cytokine and sustained-exposure context, distinguish protein secretion from Cxcl1 transcription and later CXCR2 signaling, and do not infer SCI weighting or terminal-TF mechanism.
